g.text: Shaded band = the window the paper reports as best for antifouling, about 5 to 15 percent cross-linker (workable from 1 to 50 percent); more cross-linker gives a stiffer, less swollen gel
In vitro, free-standing gels for swelling and stiffness; values approximate, read from the published figures; Jensen et al. 2021
